name: menu
description: Represents a collapsible navigation menu. On hover the three lines fold onto the middle seam and the close (X) mark is drawn over the fold; reverses on leave.

animation.description: The three lines dismiss one-by-one, top first (slight downward settle + fade), then the close X writes itself stroke by stroke via pathLength (backslash, then slash). On leave the X unwrites itself and the items return bottom-first, unless committed by click. Avoids the common rotate-bars-into-diagonals morph.

accessibility.notes: When used as a toggle, consumers should update the label between Open menu and Close menu to reflect state.
